book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Yesu Ye Weng Amun Lukbed Wongkoon

content: Bobnoon Yirimbed Ika Demboon
Kwane, Sande ari amkimo kaimbed, nima kuu baeb amun yeman nekwiwen kuu benib dumnaddem bobkonombon yaa winiwen.
Wene wedmiiwe, dumnaddem bobkonombon ambongko kebeniwen ye bot kuu kan boronmo angkanoon.
Kumban kuyaom awuniwen kuu Yariman Yesu ye bob id kuu wedmindo.
Kowe, yi kuu kwane komarewa keroon kii ande kerebkarab kamiiwe, kwane kuyaambed karub ayoob yi ebkad yaa nambirimo kumbed mene yi angkara dobiriwen.

Kwaniiwe, nima kuu uni darewoowiib kumbed bumangkenib korok kan kubune okad yiri badmendiwen. Kumban karubbed yi yaa yedmiwen, “Yiib kuu komandiwed wad doreen ye karub yaa kuu bobkonombon aombed ande onmiib?
Ye kuu keyaomban, demboon kii! Ye kuu yiib yoom Galeli yaambed komo yedmendoon kuu meenime. Kwane yedmoon kuu
‘Karub Ye Mingki kuu ambarakmidan yi dingki ari kowaniiwe, at ming arimbed aye kowaniiwe bobnaneen, kumban aron ayoobmim arimbed ika dembaneen.’ andoon kui.” andiwen.
Kwanandiiwe, yi kuu Yesumbed anuk yi yaa kwane daandoon ye weng kuu meeniwen.
Kwane, bobkonombon yirimbed ika miniwen kuu kedmengkandeendan 11iib yoom yena kuyaa doriib korem yoom yaa weng korem daandiwen.
Nima winiwen kuu Meri Magdalen yoom, Yoana yoom, Yems yawaan Meri yoom, nima yena yoombed ye apasodan keyaa kwamune daandiwen.
Kumban yi kuu nima yi weng kuu anamban andiwen, amborom kuu nima yi weng yi yaa daandiwen kuu idiibban areb ande meeniwen kowe.

Kumban Pita kuu yaro kabaanmo wene bobkonombon yiri wonoon. Wene ambongko yaambed awunbe dumnaddem bobkonombon aom wedmoon kuu ye id yaa bedmiwen ye ebkadmo angkeen. Kwane, ika wenene komarewa keroon kee ande kerebkarab kamenmo wonoon.
Kambong Emayus Kiwaan Ari
Kwane kuyaron arimbed, Yesu ye kedmengkandeendan ayoob kuu Yerusalem yaambed kambong Emayus kiwaan ari winiwen. Yonka wini kuu awas ayoob yeman.
Kwane wedya kuu, yi kuu komarewa keroon kuu yikareb neman daanoon daanoon kamiwen.

Kwane, yikareb kubiyiibban dakmenib andangkaiwe, Yesu kuu yekareb kwane angkadere yi diambed ye yoom kwane winiwen. Kumban Yesu kuu yikaadkeruni kuu Godbed kebendoon kowe, ye kuu karub maa ande meeniwen. Kwane, Yesumbed yi yaa kaamondoon, “Yiib kuu ibmo wenonib komo dowad andangkiwen?” andoon. Kwanandoone, yi kuu yinmone dobiriiwe,
yi ayoob ye karub maa yaningko Kileopas kumbed kaamonenoon, “Eb kuu Yerusalem yaa owod weneeb manok kuu kuyaom komarewa keroon kuu ebkaadbankowoo?” andoon.

Kwanandoone, Yesumbed yi yaa kaamondoon, “Komarewa keroonkob?” andoon. Kwanandoone, yimbed inandiwen, “Yesu Nasaretman kui. Ye kuu profesiman, ye kuu God ye aromkono yaambed kami yemooniib wengiib ongmenaboon. Nimakarub kuu ye kuu karub amun yeman andimaib.

Nubbed meenuwen kuu yembed Israeldan kuu yi ambarakmi yaa biddaneen ye karub kii. Kumban ye kuu God dore Yuudan dore wedyiri dobiridan yi korok korokiib nub korok korok yenayiibbed wengyundanenib aye kowi yeman ande yedmiwen. Kwane, yimbed Romdan yi dingki ari kowiiwe, ye kuu at ming yaa bakumbed dariiwe bobnoon. Kedi. Bobnoon yaambed mene kibikee aron ayoobmim kereen.
“Ma, nub nima yenambed nub yaa binangki weng yena daandiwen. Kibik amkimo bobkonombon aom winiwen,
kumban ye bob id kuu wedmindo. Kuned engyus wane wedmendiiwe yimbed nima yaa yedmendiwen kuu ‘Ye kuu wadkeroon kii.’ andiiwe, nimambed yi weng kuu nub yaa kanmene daandiwen.
Kwane, nub angkodmia yena kangkon wene konombon yiri wedmiwen kuu nimambed dakmiwen areb keroon kowe, ye kuu wedmenindo.” andiwen.
Kwanandiiwe, Yesumbed yi yaa yedmoon, “Yiib kuu ongme meenimokbandan kere profesidanbed dakmiwen yaa kuu anam andindodan areb keriwen.
Yimbed yedmiwen kuu ‘Godbed kinaneena mananeenman Keresu kuu kwamune durud yewed kandekored ye nambiri aom aomnaneen.’ andiwen.” andoon.
Kwanekore, Yesumbed ye dowad Moses ye wengiib profesidan yi wengiib ibduruk kedmengkandekore, God Ye Weng Karadmo kumundin yaambed kedmengkandoon.
Kwane, yi kuu mene kambong Emayus dia nandiwen. Kwanekorib, Yesu kuu Emayus burudande wanande kamemoon areb kamoon.
Kumban yi ayoobbed ye yaa nangkane yedmiwen, “Aron kubuneen miriknandamuun kowe, nub yoom doberekoruwa.” andiwen. Kwanandiiwe, ye kuu yi yoom dobiri yeman wonoon.
Kwane, ye kuu yi yoom arak yaa diberenib, om kande eso andekore, domangkane yi yaa bangkandoon.
Kwanoone, yi inamen kuu nandoone, ye kuu Yesu kii ande kaadkere meeneniwen. Kwaniiwe, yi indob arimbed ye kuu angkanoon.

Kwanoone, yikareb man yedmenoon yedmenoon kamiwen, “Kwane, Yesumbed kiwaan ari yarene nub yaa God Ye Weng Karadmo yaambed daandoon kuu, amot areb komberene nub niindem aom denemoon areb keroon kii.” andiwen.
Kwane kuyaambed, yaro dore ika wene Yerusalem nandekorib, kedmengkandeendan 11iib yoom karub yena yoom nedbiwen yaa winiwen.
Winiiwe, nedbiwendanbed yedmiwen, “Yariman kuu anam bobnoon yirimbed demboon kii! Yekareb Saimon yaa korokbenoon.” andiwen.
Kwanandiiwe, karub ayoobbed kiwaan wedyambed komarewa keroon kuu daandiwen. Kwane, yembed om domangkekore bangkandoone, yi inamen nandoone ye kuu Yesu ande kaadkere meeniwen ye weng kangkon dakmiwen.
Yesumbed Ye Kedmengkandeendan Yaa Angkadoroon
Kwane, karub ayoob kuu kwane dakmiiwe, Yesu kuu yekareb mimyamo keriwen aom dangkaro doberene yedmoon, “Yiib yaa yewenub kerok.” andoon.
Kwanoone, yi kuu unenib binangkiwen, amborom kuu yimbed meeniwen kuu ye kingkin wedmenuwen manok andiwen.
Kumban yembed yi yaa yedmoon, “Yiib komande uniwen? Ku wedmiwen yaa kuu komande kerebkarab kamiib?
Ne dingkia yona yaa wedmime. Nembed kei! Badmewe wedmime. Kingkin kuu yoma konoyayiibban, ne kee wedmewiib arebban.” andoon.
Yesu kuu kwane dakmekore, ye dingkia yona yaa kuburu kuu korokbendoon.
Ye kedmengkandeendan kuu binangkiyiib kubiyiib kumbed kerebkarab kamekorib, anam ande meenindo keriwen kowe, Yesumbed yi yaa kaamondoon, “Yiib kuu keyaa kee animaniiwoo?” andoon.
Kwanandoone, yimbed oon arab kamiwen kuu barad baan koniwen.
Koniiwe, yi indob arimbed oon kuu anoon.

Kwane, yembed yi yaa yedmoon, “Anuk kuu ne kuu yiib yoom doburuwen kuu kekee dakmaan, Moses ye amob wengiib profesidan yi wengiib kurikuri yokiib yaa weng korem ne dowad wongkiwen kuu anam id keraneen.” andoon.
Kwane, yembed yi inamen nandoone God Ye Weng Karadmo ye weng id kuu meeniwen.
Kowe, yembed yi yaa daandoon, “Kwane wongkiwen kuu Godbed Kinaneena Mananeenman Keresu kuu durud yewed konenib aye kowaniiwe bobnaneen, kumban aron ayoobmim arimbed ika dembaneen.
Kwane, ambarakmi yaa koronde God yaa amonombiwed are nonondandi ye weng kuu ye aningko yaambed ambibkin koremdan yaa kedmengkandaniib. Kwane, Yerusalem yaambed andowe kedmengkandaniib.
“Kowe, komarewa kamoon kuu yiib kuu wedmiwendan kui.
Nambembed yedme kowoon kuu nembed yiib yaa bangkandaniin kowe, Yerusalem aom dobaraniiwe, Ewen aom yaromkono kondaneenkob.” andoon.
Yesu Ewen Ari Nen Daanoon
Kwane, yembed bindore wene Betani diambed ye dingki kankoone yi yaa amun kerundoon.
Kwane, amun kerundeene, Yesu kuu Ewen ari nen daanoon.
Kwane, yi kuu ye aningko kankoonekorib kubi darewoowiib Yerusalem yaa ika miniwen.
Kwanekorib, yi kuu kwane doberenib kurikuri boyambib darewoob yaambed God yaa kubenimo kamiwen.
